dream.text: Under New York night the four bodies braided into one westward playout: a steady cadence—look, walk, wait—repeated until the portal drew near. The greeter’s palms opened west; the pilgrim closed from the south; the wanderer tightened an arc to listen; the watcher held the ring, sweeping wide. Sleep stitched the day into a single, quiet westward breath.
